objective: Infer compact executable musical relationships through the existing exact Rust codec; preserve observations while recovering useful harmony, voice-leading, rhythm and reusable structure.

checkpoint.summary: The exact Rust codec separates realized palettes from witnessed functional-root proposals. Shipped Mozart K330-I/K331-I strict joint root/core agreement is 63.04% / 55.93%, core 68.57% / 60.14%, with full-source Wasm inference about 0.2 / 0.6 seconds. The pinned RNBert comparator with a shared development-selected 0.01 onset threshold and predicted-tonic-scoped Rust resolution reaches 88.76% / 88.96% joint, 94.77% / 96.31% root and 92.49% / 90.79% realized core. It has known Mozart training overlap and is not shipped inference or independent validation. The requested 100% remains unmet. Observations and denominators stay fixed; abstentions and uncovered tails remain errors; no holdout is parsed.
nextActions: Close the remaining Mozart realization and boundary errors jointly. Existing learned windows cap joint agreement at 95.25% / 97.26% even under a retrospective best-label oracle; actual labels lose another 27 / 68 quarters. Preserve the frozen shared 0.01/key-scoped baseline and strict full-duration denominator. Do not use song-specific correction rules or annotation lookup.

Recover independently verifiable auxiliary target definitions and index dictionaries, or train explicit realized-tone and note-role targets under a clean work-lineage split. The released checkpoint auxiliary outputs have no published index mapping in the inspected artifacts; do not infer meanings from the Mozart reference labels. Missing implied members and replacement tones remain distinct.

Require continuity, independent seventh, ambiguity and track-repartition controls when changing scoring. Missing members can be implied by surrounding harmony; passing/neighbor motion can be structurally chordal. These musical distinctions constrain any learned or hand-written proposal.

Preserve an edited composition program independently of reanalysis. Keep source observations, authored parameters and inferred evidence distinct; a new inverse reading must not erase an authored dependency.
After representation/ranking choices are frozen, evaluate held-out work lineages once, alongside exact reconstruction, useful edits, runtime and explanatory cost.
